faqs.a:
Rules and regulations governing the shipping, transportation and storage of hazardous
               materials or hazardous waste, as promulgated by the state public utilities commission
               and the state department of health, as the same may from time-to-time be amended,
               are hereby adopted. Copies of the rules and regulations governing the shipping, transportation
               and storage of hazardous materials or hazardous wastes are available for inspection
               at the office of the city clerk.
(Code 1981, § 17-110; Ord. No. 2204, § 1, 9-3-1985;
Ord. No. 4561, § 2, 8-29-2016
)
